newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan govt to set fiscal debt target Tuesday--MOF.
newsitem.headline: Japan govt to set fiscal debt target Tuesday--MOF.

text.p: The Japanese government will formalise its goals to reduce fiscal debt on Tuesday evening, Finance Minister Hiroshi Mitsuzuka told a news conference on Tuesday.

A meeting on fiscal structural reform chaired by Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto is due to be held at 5.20 p.m. (0820 GMT) at which Hashimoto will disclose numerical targets for achieving debt reduction. At 5.55 p.m. a special cabinet session will be held to approve the plan, Mitsuzuka said.

Media reports say the plan will limit social security spending and cut annual outlays for public works spending. They say it is also likely to call for a cut in the official development assistance programme and in subsidies to farmers.
